_readme: Corrections for scripts/build_football.py. exclude: Wikidata ids (like "Q615") never to use. include: ids always to consider as legends. fix_birthplace: { "Q123": { "birth_place": "Town", "birth_country": "Country", "lat": 0.0, "lng": 0.0, "radius_km": 10 } } replaces what Wikidata says. Then run: python3 scripts/build_football.py
